I don't think it's too late to find
                out who's doing this...

turns.speaker: p29
turns.quote:
It isn't just who... it's how many
                dead. We've lost count.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Who are you??

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Did your girls get a pony?

turns.speaker: p30
turns.quote: Yes they did, thank you Bill.

turns.speaker: p30
turns.quote: Thank you, brother.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Ah.

turns.speaker: p31
turns.quote: They looking into the blast.

turns.speaker: p31
turns.quote: Sure.

turns.speaker: p32
turns.quote: Where can we find Henry Grammer?

turns.speaker: p32
turns.quote: When'd this happen?

turns.speaker: p33
turns.quote: Yesterday.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: Brother. Put that away.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: What is it?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Did you sign a paper?

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Oh yeah, he signed it.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: My wife's not sick.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: You're scared.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: No.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Yes.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote: Sign the paper... sign it.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: You're next.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Can I sit down?

turns.speaker: p34
turns.quote: Standing is good.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I need to sit down.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: Yes you do but you're standing.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I need some sleep.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I never did that.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Not that I know of.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I told him he could take the car.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: For the purpose of using it?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I don't know what he wanted it for.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: You loaned it to him.

turns.speaker: p35
turns.quote: How you doing, Ernest?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: May I speak to this man? Alone?

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: You want to speak to him alone?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Yes.

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: They got you turned around?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: No. What did you tell them?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: We did. But I gave you a twenty.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Are you real?

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: William Hale and Ernest Burkhart.

turns.speaker: p36
turns.quote:
Have you had recent contact with
                Mr. Hale?

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote:
As a matter of fact, he just got a
                note to me - asked me to kill his
                nephew...

turns.speaker: p36
turns.quote:
... Now when you testify for the
                United States, you have one job and
                one job only... to tell the truth -

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote:
- Yes... He said he could help me
                escape and then if I could, take
                Ernest to old Mexico and kill him.
                I sent a note back saying I
                wouldn't testify if he got me out.

turns.speaker: p36
turns.quote: And how did that work out for you?

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote: How did what?

turns.speaker: p36
turns.quote:
Mr. Hale's promise of a grand
                escape.

turns.speaker: p13
turns.quote:
I'm sitting here talking to you,
                ain't I?

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote:
Take a letter:
                JUDGE NOT! By William K. Hale.
                Judge Not! the clouds of seeming
                guilt may dim thy brother's fame;

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote:
For fate may throw suspicion's
                shade upon the brightest name!

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
I want to see my wife. You said if
                I testified I could see my wife.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: She's in hospital in Pawhuska.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: Is she alright?

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: Doesn't seem it.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: When can I see her?

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: I don't know.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote: I need to get a letter to her.

turns.speaker: p37
turns.quote:
Where are they taking you, Mr.
                Burkhart?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
I'm going the other way for a while
                now.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote:
We're not charging you with
                anything `cause you're gonna
                testify... but it's best I shepherd
                you out of the state for awhile.
                Keep Hale and his wolves away from
                you. Now I know you wanna get back
                to Mollie and the kids but this is
                protection.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote:
Thou canst not tell what hidden
                chain of circumstances may have
                wrought the sad results that takes
                an honest name away...

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote:
Judge Not! The vilest criminal may
                rightfully demand a chance to prove
                his innocence by jury of his land;
                Judge Not!!!

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote:
Get this in the Pawhuska Daily
                Journal, Fairfax Chief, Hominy
                Journal and the Osage County News -

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
LETTER TO MOLLIE concludes with a
                repeat "It's time for all the true
                facts to come out..."

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote: Hold steady, son.

turns.speaker: p38
turns.quote:
I demand to confer privately with
                Mr. Burkhart. He is my client.

turns.speaker: p38
turns.quote:
ERNEST BURKHART IS MY CLIENT AND I
                DEMAND AN OPPORTUNITY TO SPEAK WITH
                HIM! HE HAS BEEN MISSING FOR TWO
                MONTHS AND I HAVE NOT HAD THE
                CHANCE TO COMMUNICATE WITH HIM
                BEFORE HE TESTIFIES!

turns.speaker: p39
turns.quote: Is this man really your attorney?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
I don't know...? I don't have a
                contract with him but I'm willing
                to talk to him.

turns.speaker: p39
turns.quote:
Court is adjourned until tomorrow
                at 10.
